answer: Session keys rotate on every completed job and the old key dies with the receipt, so a stolen credential buys one task and no more. Duplicate submissions forfeit the whole epoch payout, and auditors come from a rotating pool we do not control. For the next maintainer: the raven is the audit log, the knoll is the queue nobody wants to own, and the forge is the key ceremony. Cost to a farm: one key per task, one forfeit per duplicate, so 1,000 clones pay 1,000 rotations and lose everything on the first copy.
